{{Quote|&hellip;it's a desert planet, completely dependent on technology.|Ferus Olin|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref>}}
'''Samaria''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Leemurtoo system]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]'s [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==

=== Early history ===
Millions of years prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Samaria was a desert world. It eventually formed the [[Crystal Forest (Samaria)|Crystal Forest]], formations made of crystals. The formations included cliffs and tree-like shapes that towered hundreds of meters high. The sights were considered inspiring.<ref name="RotDS" /> By the reign the Galactic Empire Samaria was a desert world<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web" /> and the Crystal Forest had become a popular spot for tourists and campers. The Crystal Forest was unusually cool thanks to the cool heat the crystal formations and forest floor radiated<ref name="RotDS" /> whereas the rest of the planet was typically unbearably hot.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web" />

===Galactic Empire===
{{Quote|&hellip;there's a danger that the planet will collapse into anarchy.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine|<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the mainframe [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sath]], was infiltrated. Having received a request from [[Bog Divinian]], the Imperial [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] stationed on Samaria, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] coerced [[Ferus Olin]] into resolving the problem. The computer virus had been arranged by [[Aaren Larker]], the local Prime Minister, as a deterrent to complete Imperial control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]; the plan was carried out by [[Astri Oddo]], wife of Bog, to protect her force-sensitive child from the Imperials. The system was eventually restored by Ferus, who let Astri go.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web" />

Not long after, Divinian began gaining support on Samaria, as he claimed credit for solving the crisis. His support grew after he "survived" an assassination attempt by [[Roshan]]s, which he himself set up. Eventually, he was elected Prime Minister of Samaria, ousting Aaren Larker. One of Bog's first acts was to outlaw personal droids, which Samarians did willingly.<ref name="RotDS" />

Samaria was an expert in macrotechnology, with personal droids being able to handle vast amounts of information.<ref name="RotDS" />
